result.quote: I found that the accusation involved questions about their own law
result.reason: The key is supported by verse 23:29, with “their own law” reasonably referring to Jewish law. However, the question asks broadly what the captain said, so other statements are equally defensible, such as that there was no charge worthy of death or imprisonment or that he sent the man after learning of a plot. The wording is also unnatural because it omits articles (“the captain,” “the letter”), and the window itself does not identify the writer as a captain or the recipient as Felix.
